test_Selector_select: test the Selector class select method to filter rows by value, list, or callable criteria
test_Selector_select_and_drop: test the Selector class select_and_drop method to filter rows and drop selection columns
test_Selector_unique: test the Selector class unique method to get unique values for one or more columns
test_Selector_assert_equivalent: test the Selector class assert_equivalent method to compare two selectors ignoring row and column order
test_Selector_constructor: test the Selector class constructor to create a Selector from index, columns, and data
